StateTree.Comment: Combat state tree for Warlock bots: AiPlayerbot.StateTree.Combat.Warlock

Task.Comment: hostile area effects on the ground around the bot: inHazard, safePosition, onHazard
mana of the bot: manaPct, onManaChanged
the unit to attack: the first living rti mark, else the dps assist choice: target, onTargetChanged; target is held back (empty, Idle waits) while the bot's threat is at 90% or more of the tank's

Task.name: Escape Hazard
Task.Comment: movement goal (MovementGoal_GlobalTask): out of a hostile area effect, also while casting, whatever the subtree's goals want

Task.name: Attack Range
Task.Comment: movement goal (MovementGoal_GlobalTask): in spell range and sight of the target
the rooms of the dungeon (InstanceSubsystem stages): stagePosition (the bot's point in the master's room, saved by rtsc), stagePositionFrom, pathBlocked

Task.name: Position Yourself
Task.Comment: movement goal: the bot's point in the master's room (rtsc / the stage file) during the fight too, above Attack Range (the bot casts from there while the target is in range)

State.name: Wand
State.Comment: out of mana: the wand until the mana is back at 20% (no regeneration while casting)

Task.Comment: placeholder until the rest of the combat exists: waits, leaves through its transitions
